{"id":"JMAP-j6ab","title":"Workspace canonical sweep: apply_jmap_patch should return invalidPatch on non-object intermediate, support array indices, reject empty segments","description":"Sweep the workspace apply_jmap_patch helpers (mail-server, contacts-server, chat-server message reactions, etc.) to strengthen RFC 8620 §5.3 compliance:

1. Return Result with an invalidPatch error variant when a non-object intermediate is encountered (currently silent no-op or clobber).
2. Support RFC 6901 array index segments (numeric segments → Vec indexing) for objects whose JSContact / JMAP type has Array-shaped fields (Calendar.name.components, ContactCard.name.components, etc.).
3. Reject empty segments (a literal '//' in a path) as invalidPatch.
4. Decode RFC 6901 escapes (~1 → /, ~0 → ~) uniformly across all sibling implementations (contacts has it; mail-server does not).

This is the canonical-template propagation track. Per workspace AGENTS.md, mail-server is the canonical extension-server. Implement the fix on mail-server first, then propagate verbatim to every sibling that has its own apply_jmap_patch (currently contacts-server; potentially chat-server message reactions and others).

Background: bd:JMAP-qz9v.4 narrowed its in-scope contacts fix to just stop the silent clobber (aligning contacts with mail-server's silent no-op). This bead is the workspace-wide follow-up to take both implementations from 'silent no-op' to 'invalidPatch error' and to add array-index support.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-05-15T09:32:26Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-05-15T09:32:26Z","metadata":{}}
new_value: {"design":"Decided 2026-10-18: implement ONE shared fn in jmap-server::helpers (foundation canonical) returning Result with invalidPatch; delete the copies in mail-server, contacts-server, filenode-server. RFC 8620 5.3 rules: parts before last MUST exist (missing parent -\u003e invalidPatch, not create); non-object parent -\u003e invalidPatch; pointer MUST NOT reference inside an array -\u003e invalidPatch (item 2 'array index support' DROPPED: contradicts RFC). Decode RFC 6901 ~1/~0. Item 3 (empty segments) only if RFC 8620/6901 require it ('' is a legal key per 6901). Replace contacts tests whose oracle was 'match mail-server' (qz9v.4) with RFC-text oracles (approved by Mark). Add AGENTS.md line: extension servers must use the shared helper."}
